Root cause: No supplier review gate before purchase or renewal
Corrective action plan: Confirm notice and renewal dates, complete due diligence, and negotiate signed security, incident, access and deletion terms.
Interim measures: Prevent expansion of data sharing and escalate before missing the renewal notice window.
Verification method: Security Assurance checks signed terms, a current in-scope assurance report or alternative evidence, and renewal disposition.

Root cause: Standing supplier support access allowed without reviewed scope

Interim measures: Restrict further access expansion and request support activity history.
Verification method: Security Assurance runs an authorized synthetic support session and checks approval, expiry, denied post-expiry access and attributable logs.
